name: print-social-digital-marketing-agency-post-with-blob-photo-and-50-percent-badge
title: 'Digital Marketing Agency' post with a blob-shaped photo and black 'Save 50%' circle badge
whatItIs: A square white post with a black, red and black headline, red 'Get started' pill, social handle row, chevron rows, a photo of a smiling man in a light suit masked into a tall organic blob with an orange edge, and a black circle badge 'Save 50% Limited offer'.
whatItMeans: Clean and sales-driven; the round badge pops against the flowing photo shape.
techniques: Mask the photo into an organic blob with a colour edge.
Overlap a circle badge onto the photo edge.
Use chevron rows as directional texture.

vocabulary.definition: An organic curved shape used to crop a photo.
